description: The sea/eraser brush (S8 difference) cuts one landmass into two unequal pieces; connected-components (S9) yields two objects, and per ADR-10 the LARGER-area piece keeps the source id/name while the smaller gets a fresh id and empty name.
geometry_notes: Land is a 400x200 rectangle. The vertical sea strip x=380..420 severs it into a large left piece (width 280) and a small right piece (width 80).
Left area (280*200) > right area (80*200) -> left keeps id 'A'.

assertions.note: The cut produces two disjoint landmasses.
The larger (left) piece retains the original id 'A' and its name.
The smaller (right) piece gets a new id and empty name.
